title: Save order of task manager when manually sorted
line: Tasks you sort by hand in the Task Manager now keep their order after plasmashell restarts and when the apps are opened again.
explanation: With manual sorting, TasksModel only kept its sort map in memory; launchers were the only tasks whose position was saved (through the launcher list). After a plasmashell restart, or when apps were opened again after login, window tasks came back in whatever order the window system listed them. TasksModel now has a manualAppOrder property: every move() writes the app ids of the tasks in their current order (keeping apps that are closed after the app they followed), and new tasks are sorted in front of the first task that comes after them in that list. The Task Manager widget stores the list in its config (manualAppOrder) and sets it back on startup. Pinned tasks that sort as their launcher are left to the launcher list.

commits.message:
libtaskmanager: remember the manual order of tasks

With manual sorting only launchers kept their position, so the order of
other tasks was lost whenever plasmashell restarted or apps reopened.
Moving a task now saves the app order, which new tasks are sorted into.

BUG: 389649

applets/taskmanager: save the manual order of tasks

The order of tasks sorted manually was only kept until plasmashell
restarted. The widget now stores the app order exposed by the tasks
model in its config and gives it back on startup, restoring the order.

BUG: 389649

patches.diff:
From 6fa1be1bc3ccbe21e0fb089a8a24eeae475171b6 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 15:20:53 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/taskmanager: save the manual order of tasks

The order of tasks sorted manually was only kept until plasmashell
restarted. The widget now stores the app order exposed by the tasks
model in its config and gives it back on startup, restoring the order.

BUG: 389649
---
 applets/taskmanager/main.xml     | 4 ++++
 applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml | 5 +++++
 2 files changed, 9 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/main.xml b/applets/taskmanager/main.xml
index 8c3b68785b..d515bb45e4 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/main.xml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/main.xml
@@ -106,6 +106,10 @@
       <label>The list of launcher tasks on the widget. Usually .desktop file or executable URLs. Special URLs such as preferred://browser that expand to default applications are supported.</label>
       <default>applications:systemsettings.desktop,applications:org.kde.discover.desktop,preferred://filemanager,preferred://browser</default>
     </entry>
+    <entry name="manualAppOrder" type="StringList">
+      <label>The app ids of tasks in the order they were last sorted in manually, used to restore that order.</label>
+      <default></default>
+    </entry>
     <entry name="middleClickAction" type="Enum">
       <label>What to do on middle-mouse click on a task button.</label>
       <choices>
diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml
index d0a62d21bc..a6cf21601b 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml
@@ -190,6 +190,11 @@ PlasmoidItem {
             Plasmoid.configuration.launchers = launcherList;
         }
 
+        manualAppOrder: Plasmoid.configuration.manualAppOrder
+        onManualAppOrderChanged: {
+            Plasmoid.configuration.manualAppOrder = manualAppOrder;
+        }
+
         onGroupingAppIdBlacklistChanged: {
             Plasmoid.configuration.groupingAppIdBlacklist = groupingAppIdBlacklist;
         }
--
